title: Aspect guideline section (section.yaml, before format version 10)
description: One section of the aspect guidelines: `_ai/aspect_guidelines/<section>/section.yaml`, beside one `<option>.md` per option (the file name without `.md` is the option's short name, its content the text sent). A prompt gets each section's effective option: the lowest level choosing one wins (section default < quest default < window < run < role type < role < item < todo); `remove` on a level sends nothing for the section. This is the format before version 10, kept for the migration: the file is now `aspect.yaml` with `choices:` (aspect-guideline.schema.json).

label.description: A short label for the selection's hover help, e.g. `Answer`. Default: the name.

placement.description: Where the chosen option's text goes: one segment of the system prompt (`system`, the default), or before the prompt text (`user`). Copilot has no system prompt: there both go before the prompt text.

default.description: The option chosen when no level chooses one (one of the section's option names). Absent: nothing is sent for the section unless a level chooses.

options.description: The options' order, by short name; each needs its `<name>.md`. Option files not listed follow by name. `remove` is no option name: it is the levels' Remove.
